theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (M : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (θ : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl (m + 1) → NVector (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1) M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), X ω = tauAction (m + 1) M θ ξ ω) → X.mass = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ∧ (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) (M \ X.support) = 0) → ∃ u : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, Measurable u ∧ (∀ x, ∃ k : ℤ, u x = k) ∧ Integrable u ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u x| = X.mass ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))), x ∉ X.support → u x = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), X ω = ∫ x, u x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
